data.gender_notes: Abdiqani is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name 'Abdiqani' is derived from the Arabic language, consisting of 'Abd' meaning servant and 'Qani' meaning forgiving. This name is often given to a boy in the Islamic community, representing the idea of being a servant to the Most Forgiving and Merciful God. The name Abdiqani carries the meaning “Servant of the Forgiving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abdiqani usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of the forgiving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder to seek forgiveness and mercy from Allah.
data.etymology: Abdiqani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of the Forgiving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abdiqani total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عبدقاني
in_arabic.long_meaning: عبد (عبدي) - عبد الله البارع (servant of Allah the diligent)، قاني (seeker) - عبد القاني (servant of the seeker)، أو عبد من قبل القاني (servant seeking Allah)

in_urdu.name: عبدقانی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عبد (عبدی) - خدا کا عبد (servant of Allah)، قانی (seeker) - خدا کے حاج کا عبد (servant of the seeker)، اور بهترین ترین توجه دیا جاتا ہوا عبد من قبل القانی (servant seeking Allah)

in_hindi.name: अब्दिकानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अब्द (अब्दी) - अल्लाह का दास (servant of Allah)، कानी (seeker) - अल्लाह के खोजे का दास (servant of the seeker)، और प्रथमतम तरह दिखाई देने वाला अब्द मन का पहले कानी (servant seeking Allah)

in_pashto.name: عبدقاني
in_pashto.long_meaning: عبد (عبدي) - خدا کا داس (servant of Allah)، قاني (seeker) - خدا که کوفر میں داس (servant of the seeker)، اور اس سے پہلے ترین شخصیت دیا جاتا ہوا عبد من قبل القانی (servant seeking Allah)
